title: Fake Toyota airbag recall notices circulating on WhatsApp, Hongkongers warned
description: Hong Kong residents have been warned about fake vehicle airbag safety recall messages circulating widely on WhatsApp, with the Chinese-language notices bearing the Transport Department’s name. A department spokesman said on Saturday that the case had been referred to police for follow-up action.
